panels.title: A/B — proxy vs direct on the same model (set the model variable)

options.content: Run some sessions with `claude-direct` (arm **direct**) and some with plain `claude` (arm **proxy**), pick **one model** above, and compare **ratios** — raw counts differ with session count and mean nothing across arms. For a *controlled* comparison use the **proxy vs direct A/B** dashboard (link at the top): scripted paired sessions tagged by `exp`. Latency is estimated from transcript timestamps (previous entry → reply), so it includes tool time only when a tool ran mid-message; compare arms, not absolutes.
